The Compensation Committee determined to weight a larger portion of Ms. Hollub's Annual Cash Incentive award opportunity toward key company performance metrics
The remaining portion was dependent on the Compensation Committee's assessment of each executive officer's individual performance in 2017.
Effective organizational development within the executive's department;
Functional and operating accomplishments within the executive's department;
Commitment to health, environment and safety principles; and
The TSR award accounted for 70% of Ms. Hollub's target long-term incentive package and 55% for the other named executive officers.
The cap on payout of the TSR award in instances of negative TSR performance over the performance period is intended to reinforce the pay-for-performance nature
The RSU award, which comprises the remainder of the 2017 long-term incentive package, vests ratably over three years
